description: This file contains the implementation of an asynchronous enumerable class, including internal state management, publishing mechanisms, and an async enumerator for iteration, within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>
classes.description: A thread-safe, publish-subscribe style asynchronous enumerable that allows publishing new values and iterating asynchronously over the sequence.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.AsyncEnumerator
classes.description: An internal class implementing IAsyncEnumerator<T> for iterating over the AsyncEnumerable sequence asynchronously.

classes.name: AsyncEnumerable<T>.Element
classes.description: Represents a node in the sequence, holding a value and a task for the next element, with support for initial and disposed states.

methods.name: TryPublish
methods.description: Attempts to publish a new element, returning a result indicating success, invalid update, or disposal.

methods.name: Publish
methods.description: Publishes a new value, throwing exceptions if the update is invalid or the sequence is disposed.

methods.name: TryPublish<TState>
methods.description: Attempts to publish a new value using an update function and state, returning a result.

methods.name: Publish<TState>
methods.description: Publishes a new value using an update function and state, throwing exceptions on failure.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes the sequence, marking it as disposed.

methods.name: GetAsyncEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an asynchronous enumerator for iterating over the sequence.
